segments.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: קָדָשִׁים שֶׁחַיָּיב בְּאַחְרָיוּתָן – יֵשׁ לָהֶן אוֹנָאָה. וְשֶׁאֵינוֹ חַיָּיב בְּאַחְרָיוּתָן – אֵין לָהֶן אוֹנָאָה. תָּנֵי תַּנָּא קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַבִּי יִצְחָק בַּר אַבָּא:
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Shimon says: Sacrificial» animals «for which one bears responsibility» to replace «them are» subject to the halakhot of «exploitation, and» those «for which one does not bear responsibility» to replace «them are not» subject to the halakhot of «exploitation.» The Gemara relates that «the tanna» who recited mishnayot and baraitot in the study hall «taught» a baraita «before Rabbi Yitzḥak bar Abba» with regard to the source of the opinion of Rabbi Shimon. It is derived from the verse: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the Lord, and deals falsely with his colleague in a matter of deposit, or of pledge, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor” (Leviticus 5:21).
